fit: red raspberry powder and mood in older adults with overweight or obesity
assessment: The completed registry schedules Profile of Mood States at baseline, two and six hours and posts no results. The 2023 investigator report gives no separate tension or anxiety estimate. A possible related serum assay supplies no mood values or independently confirmed participant linkage. The tested exposure is freeze-dried raspberry powder in a non-Parkinson cohort.

fit: previously frozen green kiwi pulp and attention tasks in healthy adults
assessment: The breakfast crossover found no clear treatment or treatment-by-time effect on choice reaction time or Stroop. ACTRN12615001259538 records the same tests. The linked Mishra metabolic report describes 200 g peeled Hayward pulp stored frozen and re-frozen after crushing. The crossover compared cereal meals in healthy volunteers and gives no Parkinson-specific estimate.
